description: Validate an Argentine bank account number (CBU) or virtual account (CVU): checks both check digits offline and returns type, entity/branch codes, bank name for major banks and a formatted value. Send {cbu}. Nothing is stored. Paid tool: 0.01 USDC per call via x402 (USDC on Base, Polygon or Solana, no account or key). An unpaid call returns a payment-required result (isError, structuredContent with x402Version 2 and accepts); sign one of the accepts and retry the same call with the PaymentPayload in params._meta["x402/payment"]. Returns JSON text; the settlement is in result._meta["x402/payment-response"].
name: ar_cbu
title: Validate Argentine CBU/CVU
